news.title: The 13 biggest announcements at Google I/O 2026 | The Verge
news.snippet: Google's I/O 2026 keynote today was once again full of AI-related announcements including a new family of Gemini 3.5 AI models, new features for Search and Gmail, and updates about its Project Aura smart glasses.

tech.title: Homepage 2026 - Student Guide to Artificial Intelligence
tech.snippet: An introduction to AI tools from a student perspective, with practical advice on using AI responsibly while in college and preparing for the AI future.
